objective: Repair a modular event delivery workflow with retries, dedupe, bounded attempts, and durable failure records.
rationale: Eight cooperating modules contain interacting timing, persistence, and idempotency behavior that requires tracing the workflow rather than changing one obvious condition.
acceptanceInvariants: A successful event is sent once and subsequent deliveries are duplicates.
Retryable failures use 100ms, 200ms, ... capped exponential delays.
Attempts never exceed maxAttempts and exhaustion is persisted as failed.
Permanent failures persist immediately without sleeping.
Failed events are not marked delivered and can be retried later.
Stored records and transport payloads do not mutate caller event data.
A capped backoff never exceeds its configured cap, including large attempt numbers.
A persistence exception propagates without marking the event delivered, so a later call can send it.
A transport receives a deep snapshot and cannot mutate the caller event.
